subject: Follow-up: Federal Bank compliance checklist & evidence timeline
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@federalbank.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@federalbank.com>
Cc: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 14:22:00 -0400
Subject: Follow-up: Federal Bank compliance checklist & evidence timeline

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the concrete next steps so we all stay aligned. I tried to keep this focused on the specific compliance asks you highlighted.

Key pain points and goals you shared:
- Audit log retention: need immutable logs for 5+ years for payments workflows, searchable by user and request id.
- SOC 2 evidence: need control mappings and evidence for logging, access reviews, change management.
- DPA/Data residency: confirmation of contractual language for EU/US data flows and subprocessor list.
- Pen test / vulnerability evidence: a consistent way to share recent pentest reports (non-prod) and remediation verification.
- Timeline: target compliance review for vendor approval by 2028-09-15.

What Redwood will provide (items we discussed):
- Artifact pack: SOC 2 controls matrix (redacted), audit-log retention design, sample log export, and a pen-test summary (redacted) — see attached draft architecture diagram and evidence matrix template.
- Short-term mitigation: optional short retention extension and export access for your auditors.
- Legal: sample DPA and subprocessor list for procurement review; we can highlight approved regions.

Asks / proposed next steps (please confirm):
1) Elena: confirm the exact retention window (you mentioned 5 years for payments, 3 years for other flows?) and whether immutable WORM storage is a hard requirement.
2) Tom / Security Team: share the procurement contact and any specific artifact format (PDF vs signed attestation) you prefer.
3) From us: we will send the artifact pack (redwood-arch-diagram.pdf, evidence-matrix-template.xlsx) by EOD tomorrow (07/26).
4) Follow-up call: propose a 30-min checklist review on Wed 07/27 or Thu 07/28 to walk the evidence pack with your security reviewer.

Attachments: redwood-arch-diagram.pdf (pdf), evidence-matrix-template.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks — happy to prioritize anything you flag.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

On Tue, Jul 25, 2028 at 09:10 AM Elena Morris <elena.morris@federalbank.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the walkthrough this morning. Looking forward to the artifacts.
>
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@federalbank.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@federalbank.com>, jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 16:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Federal Bank compliance checklist & evidence timeline

Hi Rohan —

This summary is spot on, thanks. A few clarifications from security and procurement:
- Retention: Payments event logs need 5 years WORM/immutable retention. Other customer-facing telemetry can be 3 years.
- Artifact format: PDFs for reports; an Excel matrix for control mapping is preferred.
- Pen test: we require the last full external pen test report plus a remediation one-pager showing fixes. Redactions ok for IP.
- Procurement: I will introduce you to our vendor intake lead (Tom is cc'd) and he will confirm contract requirements.

Proposed times: Wed 07/27 11:00–11:30 ET works for our security reviewer.

Elena Morris
Head of Vendor Risk | Federal Bank
elena.morris@federalbank.com

- Jasmine: prepare audit-log export sample and retention timeline docs; confirm WORM storage options and how we document immutability.

- Rohan: send calendar invite for 07/27 11:00 ET and upload materials to the HubSpot deal folder.

I'll also flag this for Legal to prepare a DPA mark-up to expedite procurement.

Jasmine Liu

Thanks Elena — confirmed for Wed 07/27 11:00 ET. Calendar invite sent.

Per the internal plan, Priyom and Jasmine are attaching the first-pass artifacts to the HubSpot deal folder and I've shared a DocuSign placeholder for a DPA (link below). Quick pointers for the call:
- We'll walk the evidence matrix row-by-row so your team can mark items that require additional rework or signatures.
- For pen test deliverables we'll present a redacted external report and a 1-page remediation summary (we'll keep vendor names redacted).
- If Federal Bank needs WORM attestation language, Legal has a standard clause we can propose during procurement.
